preconditions.expression: 2 <= int(n) <= 100 and isinstance(n, str) and n.isdigit()
preconditions.description: n is an integer between 2 and 100 inclusive, read as a string
d is an integer with absolute value ≤ 10^4, read as a string

preconditions.expression: 1 <= int(l) <= 100 and isinstance(l, str) and l.isdigit()
preconditions.description: l is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive, read as a string

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(1 <= int(x) <= int(l) for x in stdout.strip().split()) and len(stdout.strip().split()) == int(n))
postconditions.description: If no valid initial set exists, stdout is '-1'; otherwise, stdout contains exactly n integers between 1 and l inclusive, separated by spaces
If stdout is not '-1', the computed final value after all operations equals d
